overview: The Medford Human Rights Commission approved its April meeting minutes and reviewed an outreach flyer and draft event calendar for the upcoming year. The commission also heard introductions from prospective applicants ahead of upcoming vacancies and discussed the city ordinance governing the body.

items.title: Roll Call and Commissioner Introductions
items.summary: Commissioners and staff introduced themselves, with several members noting they would be stepping down from the commission at the end of their terms.

items.title: Approval of April Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the April meeting.

items.title: HRC Recruitment Flyer and Proposed Calendar
items.summary: Commissioner McDonald presented a recruitment flyer and an outline of potential city events and human rights recognitions through early 2024 to guide commission planning.

items.title: Recruitment Update and Applicant Introductions
items.summary: Staff provided an update on recruitment efforts, after which four applicants introduced themselves and discussed the backgrounds and perspectives they would bring to the commission.

items.title: Old Business: Discussion of Commission Ordinance
items.summary: Commissioners discussed SAFE Medford's recommendations regarding the Human Rights Commission ordinance and deliberated whether the current ordinance needs revision or already offers sufficient flexibility.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Public comment addressed meeting procedures, interactions with commissioners, SAFE Medford's engagement on the ordinance, and edits to the draft recruitment flyer.

items.title: Mayor Remarks and Adjournment
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn joined to thank departing commissioners for their service before the meeting adjourned.
